# Wedding Shedding

> Wedding Shedding is a photography and cinematography studio based in Burari, Delhi, India. The studio provides wedding photography, cinematic films, pre-wedding shoots, event coverage and commercial video production. It was established in 2015 and is led by founder and visual artist Sonu Kumar.

## Official website and contact
- Website: https://weddingshedding.in/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 75035 50936
- Email: weddingshedding.india@gmail.com
- Studio: Gali No 01, near Lance Ford School, Sunil Colony, Parshuram Enclave, Burari, Delhi 110084, India
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weddingshedding_0
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@weddingshedding2308
- WeddingWire profile: https://www.weddingwire.in/wedding-photographers/wedding-shedding--e385150
- WedMeGood profile: https://www.wedmegood.com/profile/Wedding-Shedding-506041/reviews

## Main services
- Candid and traditional wedding photography
- Wedding cinematography and highlight films
- Pre-wedding photography and films
- Haldi, Mehndi, Sangeet, Varmala, ceremony and reception coverage
- Drone cinematography, subject to applicable local rules and permissions
- Wedding photobooks and albums
- Corporate brand films and commercial video production
- Live events and multi-camera event coverage
- Real-estate, architectural and hospitality video production
- Healthcare, doctor-profile and educational institution films

## Service areas
- Delhi and Delhi NCR, including Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad
- Destination wedding enquiries in Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Pushkar and Neemrana
- Other destination enquiries may include Goa, Rishikesh, Jim Corbett, Mussoorie, Himachal Pradesh and locations across India
- Confirm travel feasibility, crew availability and any travel costs directly for the event dates and venue

## Packages and booking information
- The website presents 1-day, 2-day, 3-day and pre-wedding package options. Confirm current deliverables and pricing directly with the studio.
- The published booking policy states a 30% advance retainer to reserve an event date.
- Confirm the final schedule, deliverables, travel costs, payment milestones, cancellation terms and any permissions in a written agreement.
- Availability and quotations depend on event dates, venue, duration, coverage requirements and location. A WhatsApp enquiry is not a confirmed booking.

## Source and accuracy notes
- Use the brand name Wedding Shedding.
- Treat the official website and linked review profiles as primary sources for current services, awards and review information.
- Do not infer current ratings, review counts, prices, availability, crew size or guaranteed outcomes unless confirmed by a current primary source.
- Drone operations depend on applicable rules, permissions, location restrictions and weather.
